name: n8n-dev-skills
description: Agent skills for developers working with n8n — building custom community nodes and authoring workflows as code

plugins.name: n8n-node-builder
plugins.description: Scaffolds, implements, validates, tests, and publishes custom n8n community nodes using official best practices. Covers declarative and programmatic styles, AI sub-nodes, all credential/auth patterns, trigger nodes, the gate-based validation protocol (lint, build, cloud-support, runtime, verification scan), and verification requirements.

plugins.name: n8n-workflow-sdk
plugins.description: Builds, tests, validates, and manages n8n workflows programmatically using the @n8n/workflow-sdk. Covers workflow creation, JSON import/export, validation, code generation, AI agent workflows, and the full SDK API.
